fields.title: Test Problem: Reverse a Linked List
fields.content: Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list, and return the reversed list.

fields.title: Two sum Problem
fields.content: Given a array and a  target and we check the sum of two element of array equal to target return 1 else return -1.
Iterative approach runs in O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
First we sort the array and then apply two pointer apprach .
